preop_alignment: RCS in mid-loop condition; IRWST >25% level; RNS suction aligned to RCS; V023 opened, RCS level increase verified, then V023 closed
validated_function: V023 changes position under the documented preoperational differential-pressure/flow alignment; ICN states this alignment establishes its greatest preoperational differential-pressure and flow conditions
remaining_closure: Actual inlet/outlet pressure traces and differential pressure; flow through V023; valve stroke/opening/closure timing; motor electrical/diagnostic records; exact piping geometry
do_not_infer: Do not substitute the 370-400-psig hot-RCS isolation envelope for V023 and do not infer a numerical valve DP from RCS/IRWST levels alone
notes: Reference 7 / SV3-RNS-ITR-803375 is the preferred raw-result route.

preop_alignment: RCS >275°F and 370-400 psig; both RNS trains in service; manual RNS isolation actuation; listed MOVs verified closed
validated_function: The listed Unit-3 MOVs transfer closed under the documented hot/pressurized preoperational RNS isolation alignment
remaining_closure: Individual valve inlet/outlet pressures, differential pressure and flow; command timing; individual stroke times; PMS channels; motor/actuator diagnostics; valve-specific test tolerances
do_not_infer: Do not equate RCS pressure with differential pressure across any individual MOV and do not infer design-load margin from this system-level alignment
notes: Reference 8 / SV3-RNS-ITR-804375 is the preferred raw-result route.

preop_alignment: RNS filled/vented and RCS available to receive water; downstream piping isolated; available water connection directs water through valve to RCS; water isolated and system vent opened; upstream water head closes valve; non-intrusive equipment verifies closure
validated_function: Thermal-relief check valves demonstrate transfer open and transfer closed under documented test conditions
remaining_closure: Exact water head/pressure/flow, test connection tags, vent tag, non-intrusive diagnostic equipment/results, valve-specific leakage/acceptance data and piping branch geometry
do_not_infer: Do not infer normal operating thermal-relief branch pressure drop or installed spring/trim from this functional test
notes: Reference 9 / SV3-RNS-ITR-805375 is the raw-result route.

preop_alignment: RCS at 73.5%-86.5% hot-leg level; temporary flow instruments on DVI lines; dual RNS pumps recirculating RCS; opening verified by DVI flow; V017A/B closure subsequently tested with RNS removed from service using PXS test header; V013 isolated/drained and upstream side air-pressurized for no-leakage verification
validated_function: Discharge-header containment-isolation and RCS-pressure-boundary check valves demonstrate required position changes under documented alignments
remaining_closure: Valve-specific flows/pressures, temporary instrument IDs/calibration, leakage values, non-intrusive traces, test-header configuration and exact discharge piping geometry
do_not_infer: Do not transfer the V013 air leakage method to V017A/B or infer valve internal dimensions from the test method
notes: Reference 9 contains multiple valve-specific methods that must remain separate.

preop_alignment: RCS drain-down condition with head set and RCS vented; one RNS pump started; opening verified by individual DVI-line plant instrumentation; flow stopped and closure verified by non-intrusive equipment; repeated by train
validated_function: RNS discharge RCS-pressure-boundary check valves demonstrate required opening/closure during the documented drain-down alignment
remaining_closure: Exact head/pressure/temperature, pump used per train, DVI flow values, plant-instrument tags, non-intrusive traces and leakage/acceptance criteria
do_not_infer: Do not assume symmetric measured values or identical diagnostic response between V015A and V015B
notes: Reference 9 / ITR-805375 is required for valve-specific data.
